adaptations: additive onboarding (ADR-0001): installed only pure-Node checks (traceability, trajectory, coverage/eval ratchets, acceptance, process ratchet, integrity, ledger, correct, gate-status); Playwright/JS-app scripts, .claude/* and package.json deliberately not installed (.githooks and a factory-gates workflow were added later by ADR-0002)
check-traceability and check-acceptance-methods adapted to this repo: also scan frontend/src and count *Test.java/*Tests.java as tests for @trace tags
quality/telemetry.config.json: local-verifiable mechanism declared as scripts/dod.mjs (weak existence check); repo has no root package.json
check-coverage-ratchet and check-eval-ratchet installed because gate-status calls them, but not applicable here (no JS coverage or eval artifacts): they report NOT-EARNED
lock also covers pre-existing repo gates scripts/check-*.mjs and .github/workflows/*.yml as found at onboarding

ADR-0002: .githooks/pre-commit and commit-msg (adapted hooks: no ESLint/tsc, warn-only trailers) and .github/workflows/factory-gates.yml (integrity hard gate, Dependabot skipped) added and locked in the same commit as the wiring; ci.yml and .claude/settings.json unchanged

check-factory-integrity.mjs: .github/workflows/ joins the soft tier (drift is a warning plus a ledger event) because Dependabot github-actions bumps auto-merge and edit those files; scripts and .githooks stay hard-locked (ADR-0002)

ADR-0004: scripts/gate-status.mjs restores the hook-owned reports and trace/*.json that its release variants rewrite (scripts/generated-files.mjs, imported next to hooks-pre-commit.mjs); factory-gates.yml gains a pinned openspec validate --strict step; scripts/check-trace-scanners.test.mjs joins the lock because its name matches scripts/check-*.mjs

ADR-0005 (slice 1, gate-status-explicit): scripts/check-specs.mjs accepts scripts/*.test.mjs › "title" references and checks the acceptance tables of active OpenSpec slice proposals, and in a pull request of each proposal the branch adds; scripts/check-specs.test.mjs pins it

ADR-0005 (slice 2, structured-test-evidence): scripts/check-specs.mjs prSpecProblems diffs with -M and checks only archived proposals the branch adds (validateSpecs checks the active ones); scripts/check-specs.test.mjs pins it

ADR-0005 (slice 3 step A, review-provenance-local): scripts/check-review.mjs counts a verdict only on a hook-recorded reviewer line (toolu_ id, its PreToolUse line, the reviewer's hand-back or Agent call) and an APPROVE only with blocking === 0; scripts/check-review.test.mjs pins it, with the #52 replay
